SELECT nt.id, ANY_VALUE(o.order_no) AS relNo, CAST(ANY_VALUE(o.status) AS SIGNED) AS status, ANY_VALUE(o.estimated_arrival_time) AS estimatedServerTime, ANY_VALUE(o.create_time) AS createTime, ANY_VALUE(o.update_time) AS orderUpdateTime, ANY_VALUE(e.name) AS elderName, ANY_VALUE(e.bed_number) AS bedNumber, ANY_VALUE(np.name) AS projectName, ANY_VALUE(CASE WHEN nt.task_type = 2 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) AS taskType, ANY_VALUE(creator.real_name) AS creator, ANY_VALUE(updater.real_name) AS updater, ANY_VALUE(nt.update_time) AS updateTime FROM nursing_task nt INNER JOIN `order` o ON nt.rel_no = o.order_no INNER JOIN elder e ON o.elder_id = e.id INNER JOIN nursing_project np ON o.project_id = np.id LEFT JOIN sys_user creator ON nt.create_by = creator.id LEFT JOIN sys_user updater ON nt.update_by = updater.id LEFT JOIN nursing_elder ne ON e.id = ne.elder_id
GROUP BY nt.id ORDER BY MAX(nt.create_time) DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE nursing_task SET mark = #{mark}, task_image = #{taskImage}, update_by = #{userId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{taskId}
UPDATE `order` o INNER JOIN nursing_task nt ON o.order_no = nt.rel_no SET o.status = #{status}, o.update_time = NOW() WHERE nt.id = #{taskId}

UPDATE `order` o INNER JOIN nursing_task nt ON o.order_no = nt.rel_no SET o.status = 5, o.reason = #{reason}, o.refund = o.amount, o.is_refund = 'YES', o.update_time = NOW(), nt.status = 3, nt.cancel_reason = #{reason}, nt.update_by = #{userId}, nt.update_time = NOW() WHERE nt.id = #{taskId}
UPDATE `order` o INNER JOIN nursing_task nt ON o.order_no = nt.rel_no SET o.estimated_arrival_time = FROM_UNIXTIME(#{estimatedServerTime} / 1000), o.update_time = NOW() WHERE nt.id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT nt.id, o.order_no AS relNo, o.status, o.estimated_arrival_time AS estimatedServerTime, o.create_time AS createTime, e.name AS elderName, e.bed_number AS bedNumber, e.id_card_no AS idCardNo, e.age, e.sex, e.phone, np.name AS projectName, np.image AS projectImage, np.unit AS projectUnit, CASE WHEN nt.task_type = 2 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS taskType, creator.real_name AS creator, updater.real_name AS updater, nt.mark, nt.task_image AS taskImage, nt.update_time AS updateTime, o.reason FROM nursing_task nt INNER JOIN `order` o ON nt.rel_no = o.order_no INNER JOIN elder e ON o.elder_id = e.id INNER JOIN nursing_project np ON o.project_id = np.id LEFT JOIN sys_user creator ON nt.create_by = creator.id LEFT JOIN sys_user updater ON nt.update_by = updater.id WHERE nt.id = #{taskId}
SELECT nt.id, o.order_no AS relNo, o.status FROM nursing_task nt INNER JOIN `order` o ON nt.rel_no = o.order_no WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo} AND nt.task_type = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT nursing_id FROM nursing_elder WHERE elder_id = #{elderId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nursing_task ( nursing_id, project_id, elder_id, bed_number, task_type, estimated_server_time, status, rel_no, create_time, create_by ) SELECT ne.nursing_id, npp.project_id, e.id, e.bed_number, 2, STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-'), '01 ', npp.execute_time, ':00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), 1, CONCAT('MP-', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m'), '-', e.id, '-', npp.project_id), NOW(), 0 FROM elder e INNER JOIN check_in_config cic ON e.id = cic.elder_id INNER JOIN nursing_level nl ON cic.nursing_level_id = nl.id AND nl.status = 1 INNER JOIN nursing_plan np ON nl.lplan_id = np.id INNER JOIN nursing_project_plan npp ON np.id = npp.plan_id AND npp.execute_cycle = 2 LEFT JOIN nursing_elder ne ON e.id = ne.elder_id WHERE e.status = 4 AND NOW() BETWEEN cic.cost_start_time AND cic.cost_end_time AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM nursing_task nt WHERE nt.elder_id = e.id AND nt.project_id = npp.project_id AND nt.task_type = 2 AND DATE_FORMAT(nt.create_time, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m') )
mapper.update: UPDATE nursing_task SET estimated_server_time = STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d '), DATE_FORMAT(estimated_server_time, '%H:%i:%s')), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), update_time = NOW() WHERE task_type = 2 AND status = 1 AND estimated_server_time < CURDATE()
